primary_antecedent.scope: Remove both individual radial-vector exclusions from the ordinary sufficient quarter-corank and universal necessary twelfth-corank estimates.
primary_antecedent.qualification: No optimal varying-rank converse or unrestricted general-rho extension is inferred.

source_correspondence: Full joint-puncture closure and both missing axes give compact normalized relation supports and exact frequency comparison; ordinary symbols and finite bundles retain their true hypotheses.
Compact-frequency kernels have a full uniform Schur estimate. Every Schwartz remainder norm, derivative and spatial weight is defined and controlled before a bounded extension is used.

Fourier, chirp, linear-density and affine operators are exactly unitary. The diagonal-complement proof gives a finite factorization of every symplectic matrix; upper-shear signs and all inverses are explicit.

Actual annularization of the original kernel includes both noncomparable frequency tails. A displayed joint-radius integral handles negative orders, every derivative and spatial weight, with explicit powers before choosing the number of integrations.
Ordinary tangent splitting permits n=0. Actual mixed coordinates and a closed one-form primitive give the whole local phase and exact vanishing two-jet without a homogeneous-coordinate assumption.

Affine Fourier transformations preserve phase nondegeneracy and exact prefactors. Full cutoff symbols equal one on open retained supports, so their complete stationary expansions supply identity to all orders, not only in a principal quotient.

The partial stationary Hessian is proved nonsingular by its tangent kernel and the actual projection diffeomorphism. Uniform stationary phase gives actual compact amplitudes, every differentiated remainder, the precise h exponent and a nonzero classical leading coefficient.

A fixed-h Hilbert-Schmidt graph operator is formed before its adjoint product. An actual uniformly invertible compact-frequency change and the Schur bound give the uniform graph-family estimate, including n=0.

The actual Hilbert parameter integral retains the two volume factors and h^(-m-k/4). Properly retained affine inverse changes and a finite normalized cover prove the band estimate even when rank changes.

The band sum uses both input and output frequency overlaps, strong convergence and the actual kernel identity. Fourier Hilbert-Schmidt tails and the low band are summed with their exact volume powers.
Every real Sobolev consequence retains both proper elliptic reconstruction errors, compact smooth approximation and agreement with the original distributional action.

Necessity uses one fixed ordinary classical kernel, uniformly bounded phase-space probes and exact unitaries. The nonzero leading coefficient survives the actual stationary reduction; an arbitrary varying family is not substituted for the universal hypothesis.

The cubic packets have shared scale h^(1/2), nongraph scale h^(1/3), all mixed cubic weights and a fourth-order remainder. One integrable Fourier majorant covers the entire rescaled frequency integral and every real m.

An explicit compact profile gives a nonzero local output limit. The distinct input and output norm Jacobians yield h^(-m-k/12), forcing the pointwise necessary bound for that same fixed operator, also when n=0.

Three complete solutions include a globally closed axis-free conic relation with actual zero shared block and both radial tangencies, its stronger sharp flat-germ bound, the zero-shared-variable cubic packet and the full finite-overlap inequality.
Thirty-five exact checks verify dimension, prefactor, symplectic shear, cubic-weight, Jacobian, form and overlap identities. They do not certify the analytic proof.
